prepared_answers.question: Why did Arnold say Satan cannot postpone God’s plan indefinitely?
prepared_answers.summary: Arnold said Satan cannot choose to remain in heaven indefinitely and will be cast out when Michael acts. He also described Satan’s pride as sustaining his belief that he can change the outcome.

prepared_answers.question: Did Arnold think Revelation 17’s ten kings could be rulers of countries?
prepared_answers.summary: Arnold answered that these were rulers in the final generation and said that identification was possible, rather than naming specific leaders.

prepared_answers.question: Did Arnold mean everyone must survive the whole fig-tree generation?
prepared_answers.summary: Arnold distinguished the span of a generation from each individual’s lifespan. He said the elect, except the two witnesses, would live to its end. A phrase in the captions is damaged and requires audio checking.
